MarkdownFileReference.description: A reference to a markdown file containing detailed content about a priority pathogen.

path.description: Relative path to the markdown file from the project root. Must end with .md extension.

MarkdownFileReference.title: MarkdownFileReference

Outbreak.description: Definition of a priority pathogen with its taxonomic classification, priority level, and associated resources.

active.description: Boolean flag that determines if the pathogen should be included in the BRC Analytics interface. Used to manage visibility as pathogen relevance changes over time.

description.description: Reference to a markdown file containing detailed information about the pathogen.

highlight_descendant_taxonomy_ids.description: List of NCBI Taxonomy IDs for descendant taxa (e.g., specific strains or serotypes) that should be highlighted within the outbreak category.

name.description: The display name of the pathogen as it will appear in the BRC Analytics interface.

precomputed.description: Optional pre-computed workflow results for this pathogen, including how to discover eligible runs and where the published results are.

priority.description: The priority level of the pathogen, which determines its visibility and prominence in the BRC Analytics interface.

resources.description: Collection of external resources (references, tools, databases) related to the pathogen.

taxonomy_id.description: The NCBI Taxonomy ID for the pathogen. Used to link to relevant genomic data and workflows.

OutbreakResource.description: Definition of an external resource (reference, tool, database) associated with a priority pathogen.

title.description: The display title for the resource link as it will appear in the BRC Analytics interface.

type.description: The category or type of the resource (e.g., REFERENCE, TOOL, DATABASE), which determines how it is displayed and organized.

url.description: The complete URL (including http/https protocol) to the external resource.

PrecomputedDiscovery.description: Criteria for discovering public sequencing runs to process with a workflow.

first_public_from.description: Only runs first made public on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD) are discovered.

instrument_platform.description: The instrument platforms that discovered runs may have (e.g., 'ILLUMINA').

library_layout.description: The library layout that discovered runs must have.

library_source.description: The library source values that discovered runs may have.

library_strategy.description: The library strategy values that discovered runs may have.

taxonomy_id.description: The NCBI Taxonomy ID to discover runs for, if different from the taxonomy ID of the pathogen.

PrecomputedDiscovery.title: PrecomputedDiscovery

PrecomputedRelease.description: Details of a published set of pre-computed results.

last_updated.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) the results were last updated.

manifest_url.description: Location of the manifest describing the published results, as a path relative to the configured release base URL, or a complete URL (including http/https protocol) where the results are hosted elsewhere.

record_count.description: The number of records in the published results.

PrecomputedRelease.title: PrecomputedRelease

PrecomputedResults.description: Pre-computed results of a workflow run on public data for a pathogen.

discovery.description: Criteria for discovering public sequencing runs to process. If omitted, runs are not discovered automatically.

release.description: Details of the latest published results. If omitted, no results are shown.

workflow_trs_id.description: The TRS ID of the workflow (including version) used to compute the results.
